Change c0045. Location: 1818 Letter IV; 1831 Letter IV.

Context before (unchanged): This promise drew from me the warmest thanks.

1818 text: I have resolved every night, when I am not engaged, to record, as nearly as possible in his own words, what he has related during the day.

1831 text: I have resolved every night, when I am not imperatively occupied by my duties, to record, as nearly as possible in his own words, what he has related during the day.

Diff: I have resolved every night, when I am not [-engaged-] {+imperatively occupied by my duties+} , to record, as nearly as possible in his own words, what he has related during the day.

Context after (unchanged): If I should be engaged, I will at least make notes.

result.rationale: Replaces "engaged" with "imperatively occupied by my duties," a rephrasing that keeps Walton's sense of being busy but adds an explicit notion of duty, a minor stylistic and slightly moralizing emphasis.
